Sari Schorr, Joe Hicks

Tuesday, September 29, 19:00
adv £25

8pm Joe Hicks
8.45pm Sari Schorr

Celebrate the official London launch of Running Wild, the powerful new album from Sari Schorr, released on Provogue / Mascot Label Group.

Following the Billboard #1 success of Joyful Sky with Robin Trower, Schorr returns with her most ambitious and defining work to date. Running Wild is a fearless collection of songs where rock, soul and blues collide—driven by cinematic songwriting, electrifying musicianship and one of the most compelling voices in modern rock.

This exclusive one-night-only event marks the beginning of a new chapter. Experience the new album performed live for the first time in London, alongside fan favourites from across Sari's acclaimed catalogue, in an intimate setting designed to bring artist and audience closer than ever.

"Her live shows are becoming unmissable events.” — Powerplay Rock & Metal Magazine
